Data:Salon.pref.rep.block.zachary.json.label: Zachary's Meal Preferences
Data:Salon.pref.rep.block.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary will only attend if there's something to eat with <sprite name=winter>.

Data:Salon.recent.hint.json.label: Not Just Now -
Data:Salon.recent.hint.json.startdescription: [You can only hold one Salon each season.]

Data:Salon.refectory.json.label: A Salon in the Refectory
Data:Salon.refectory.json.desc: The room where once the Curia met: a fitting venue for a Salon. [Here one might serve Lunch in the afternoon, or Supper in the evening. A good host will provide at least one first course, one main course, one side dish, and one pudding.]

slots.label: Secretary Persistent
slots.description: In Hush House, an empty place is often traditionally left at table for Rowena, protectress of Hush House, and once Secretary Persistent of the Curia of the Isle. [If you one day propose a successor for Rowena... seat them here.]
